text:
Type: glass-door display cabinet on stand
Use: showing glassware, ceramics or collections; living room, dining room, home office
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, industrial
Materials: solid pine frame with visible knots, clear glass doors and sides, glass shelves, dark grey-stained wooden stand
Colors: light natural pine, dark grey base, clear glass
Shape: tall glass box with slim wooden corner posts, two glass doors with a small central handle, raised on a four-legged stand with stretchers, light and see-through
Feel: natural, airy, honest, warm
Goes with: pine or oak, linen, ceramics, black accents; rustic, Scandinavian or industrial dining rooms

product.name: NORNS
product.description: Untreated solid pine is a durable natural material that can be painted, oiled or stained according to preference.
